mapper.select: select DISTINCT bo.id, bo.order_no, bo.product_id, bp.name as productName, bo.product_num, bo.status, bo.cost_points, bo.cancel_time, bo.finish_time, bo.remark, bo.update_time, bo.update_user, bo.create_user, bo.create_time, su.nickname as customerName, su2.nickname AS updateUserString from biz_order bo left join biz_product bp on bo.product_id = bp.id left join sys_user su on bo.create_user = su.id left join sys_user su2 ON bo.update_user = su2.id ${ew.customSqlSegment} order by bo.status asc, bo.create_time desc

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t1.product_num), 0) FROM biz_order AS t1 WHERE t1.product_id = #{productId} AND t1.status in (1,2,3) AND t1.deleted = 0 AND YEAR(t1.create_time) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) AND MONTH(t1.create_time) = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE())

select DISTINCT bo.id, bo.order_no, bo.product_id, bp.name as productName, bo.product_num, bo.status, bo.cost_points, bo.remark, bo.create_time from biz_order bo left join biz_product bp on bo.product_id = bp.id ${ew.customSqlSegment} order by bo.create_time desc

select DISTINCT bo.id, bo.order_no, bo.product_id, bp.name as productName, bo.product_num, bo.status, bo.cost_points, bo.remark, bo.create_time, su.nickname as customerName, su2.nickname AS updateUserString from biz_order bo left join biz_product bp on bo.product_id = bp.id left join sys_user su on bo.create_user = su.id left join sys_user su2 ON bo.update_user = su2.id ${ew.customSqlSegment} order by bo.status asc, bo.create_time desc
